recipe.name: Hibiscus Paloma
recipe.description: A vibrant and spicy twist on the classic Paloma, combining rich gold tequila with tart grapefruit, floral hibiscus, and a lingering chili heat.
steps: Muddle the chilli slices gently in the bottom of a shaker.
Add the Camino Gold, fresh grapefruit juice, hibiscus syrup, and ice to the shaker.
Fine strain into a highball glass filled with fresh ice cubes.
Top up with soda water and stir gently to combine.
recipe.garnish: Grapefruit wheel and a fresh chilli slice
recipe.serving: Served cold in a highball glass over ice
